comment:
* LinkifyCompat brings in {@code Linkify} improvements for URLs and email addresses to older API
 * levels.

methods.name: public static boolean addLinks(@NonNull Spannable text, @LinkifyMask int mask)
methods.comment:
*  Scans the text of the provided Spannable and turns all occurrences
     *  of the link types indicated in the mask into clickable links.
     *  If the mask is nonzero, it also removes any existing URLSpans
     *  attached to the Spannable, to avoid problems if you call it
     *  repeatedly on the same text.
     *
     *  @param text Spannable whose text is to be marked-up with links
     *  @param mask Mask to define which kinds of links will be searched.
     *
     *  @return True if at least one link is found and applied.

methods.name: public static boolean addLinks(@NonNull TextView text, @LinkifyMask int mask)
methods.comment:
*  Scans the text of the provided TextView and turns all occurrences of
     *  the link types indicated in the mask into clickable links.  If matches
     *  are found the movement method for the TextView is set to
     *  LinkMovementMethod.
     *
     *  @param text TextView whose text is to be marked-up with links
     *  @param mask Mask to define which kinds of links will be searched.
     *
     *  @return True if at least one link is found and applied.

methods.name: public static void addLinks(@NonNull TextView text, @NonNull Pattern pattern, @Nullable String scheme)
methods.comment: * Applies a regex to the text of a TextView turning the matches into * links. If links are found then UrlSpans are applied to the link * text match areas, and the movement method for the text is changed * to LinkMovementMethod. * * @param text TextView whose text is to be marked-up with links * @param pattern Regex pattern to be used for finding links * @param scheme URL scheme string (eg http://) to be * prepended to the links that do not start with this scheme.
